verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm selling legal services, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Its client-facing tech (a trademark extranet, AI brief and contract review tools, Fenwick Labs utilities) is described only as firm-internal or client-portal tooling. Nothing in the evidence suggests any of it is an agent that could accept user-plugged MCP servers, so the axis does not apply.
